team: LUIS ENRIQUE: “THIS IS A NIGHT TO REMEMBER FOREVER!” ✨ PSG
speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Good evening, we can now begin the post-match press conference.
Paris Saint-Germain against Bayern Munich. Please ask your questions to Luis Enrique in French or German.
Good evening, coach. The match was on Tuesday. Today is Wednesday.
So please, short questions. We will be quick. You can understand that, no? OK, we will see.
Good evening, coach. Right at the back. Arthur Perrault, RMC. I am here, right at the back.
Everyone seems to agree that tonight we experienced a historic Champions League match.
And having met a few supporters, they all say they will have trouble falling asleep tonight.
Do you share those two opinions? Thank you.
I think it was a very different match, with two teams at an incredible level.
I think both teams showed what kind of football we are about. And I can say that I am so tired.
If I am tired, and I did not run a kilometre like the players had to do, imagine the players.
The match had everything, because I think they started the match better than us.
They scored the goals and they created a lot of chances.
After that, we changed the match in a difficult way, but we overcame that result.
In the second half, I think we started better than them and we scored three goals.
We were in an incredible state, and after that we conceded two goals. It was a match with different situations all the time.
I think it is a moment to congratulate the team and everyone who was in the stadium.
I am so tired that now I have to talk about the match in one week.
We have to analyse this match. Of course, there are aspects we can improve.
And when you face a team with that individual and collective quality, it is very difficult.
I think we defended very well. We improved our defensive level, but we conceded four goals.
It is so different from the normality of the matches you play that we have to analyse this match.
We have to rest and recover, to think first about the league match.
And after that, we will see. But I think the return match will be the same as this one.
Good evening, coach. Giovanni Castelli, L'Équipe channel. At 5-2, after the fifth goal,
we saw you really explode with joy. Tell us what went through your head at that moment.
And straight after that, you made the changes with Fabian and Warren.
Was that to lower the intensity a little and keep more control with Fabian's profile in midfield?
I think the rhythm of this match was very different from normal.
When everything is played at this intensity, I think the players who came on contributed a lot.
It is simply the capacity we have as a team to manage the minutes.
I think Fabian came on very well, Senny Mayulu too, and Bradley Barcola too.
It is important for us to make the most of the players who come off the bench.
It was the best moment of the match, but I held myself back.
I preferred not to think that it was a match at 5-2, because the quality of this Bayern team is very clear.
The intensity of the match throughout was exceptional.
We won the match. It is clear that we are happy, very happy, but after 5-2 you think you can get a better result.
But I think we deserved to win this match, we deserved to draw it and we also deserved to lose it.
Good evening, Philippe Sanfourche for RTL, right at the top. The Bayern coach, Vincent Kompany,
has just called for madness in their stadium in Munich in one week.
He thinks it will be the same type of match, completely crazy. Are you preparing to have to score four or five goals again to qualify?
I asked my staff the same question five minutes ago.
How many goals do you think we needed to win this match? Minimum three. That is what we think.
And in one week we are going to Munich, which is a stadium we like, a stadium that brings back good memories for us.
We won our first Champions League in Munich, and for us it is a special place.
Of course, Bayern Munich, their stadium and their supporters are even stronger there,
but for us it is a great opportunity to play there and we will try to show the same mentality.
If we can improve, that is our objective, and we will try to win the match. That is clear for us.
Last question. Good evening, Alice Lefebvre for AFP.
Kvaratskhelia and Dembélé shone again in a big match. Can you talk to us about their match?
And can you give us some news on Hakimi, please? Thank you.
I do not know anything. Tomorrow we will see what Hakimi's condition is.
I cannot say anything in advance. And today, I think we can talk about the attackers,
because they are the players who score the goals. But today, I think both teams showed it,
all the players who played, and all the supporters who enjoyed this match.
I think we enjoyed this type of football, in this atmosphere, in this stadium. It is a night to remember forever.
And we will try to play the same match in one week. Thank you.
title: LUIS ENRIQUE: “THIS IS A NIGHT TO REMEMBER FOREVER!” ✨ PSG 5-4 Bayern Munich
